descriptions.before: Creates a Decal instance that uses composite PBR textures created by layering the provided textures in the order they are provided in the layers array. Textures layer based on the alpha value of the ColorMap.
descriptions.after: Modifies an existing Decal to contain a composite PBR textures created by layering the provided textures in the order they are provided in the layers array. Textures layer based on the alpha value of the color map.
A Decal instance that will be modified to contain a representation of the layers. Any existing maps on this instance will be cleared.

descriptions.after: An array of dictionary tables that maps PBR names to Content IDs.
